basic_info.description: 1627 48th ave is a five (5) unit building located on between Lawton and Moraga.  Two (2) units will be delivered vacant including a top-floor, 2bd-1ba unit with excellent light, corner windows, and West-facing views of the sand and waves on Ocean Beach. Investors can enjoy a 6.0%+ cap rate and 11.06 GRM once the two vacant units have been rented. The unit mix consists of three (3) 1-bedroom units and two (2) 2-bedroom units. There are 5 parking spaces. 1627 48th Ave is a true opportunity for both owner-users and investors.
